- the nine zero-consumer modules and their barrel lines: `core/src/builder/schema-builder.ts`, `core/src/protocols/{Dnd,Keyboard,Sharing}Protocol.ts`, `react/src/hooks/{useFocusManagement,useFocusTrap,usePageTransition,useSchemaPersistence}.ts`, `collaboration/src/LiveCursors.tsx` (plus the comment mentions in `types/src/index.ts`);
- `packages/runner/package.json` → `private: true`, and its entry out of `.changeset/config.json`'s fixed group;
- the `reset*ForTesting`-style helpers off the public barrels (core ×5, app-shell, types, plugin-detail), moved to `@object-ui/test-support` or tagged `@internal`, whichever the repo's existing pattern is;
- the `@object-ui/providers` trio (`DataSourceProvider`, `MetadataProvider`, `ThemeProvider` + hooks), the hand-written exemptions in `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, and `examples/byo-backend-console/src/App.tsx` repointed at `@object-ui/react`;
- their tests; one changeset per package.
(Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
⛔ Not in this claim:
- `@object-ui/plugin-ai`: retire or wire it is the maintainer's call;
- `UploadProvider` / upload-adapter folding and retiring the providers package;
- the root and config orphans; the per-package zero-reference batches;
- `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` in `data-objectstack`: seat 1's objectui#13442 holds `packages/data-objectstack/src/**`, so it waits for that card;
- the 122 dead i18n keys: objectui#13460's second pass is editing the same locale packs; they ride a second PR on this card after objectstack-ai/objectstack#25916's PR merges, with an amendment.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: default tier (no path-derived mandate)`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (nothing added a consumer or author can target)
Metadata-protocol: none (code exports, not metadata). Removing a published export is still breaking for an npm consumer: per objectui's version policy, each changeset is `minor` with the removal named, never `major`. Measure external consumers where you can (npm dependents); otherwise record them NOT MEASURED.
Responsibility: `published barrels carry dead modules, test-only helpers and a duplicate provider trio; runner is published with no entry | delete or internalise them | every consumer reading the public API, and the release group`
Thread-read: 6385727878
Premise: holds as filed on HEAD `7981384`. Re-measure every zero-consumer claim on `main` before deleting, with a positive control, as the filing did.
Serial constraints cleared: seat 1's objectui#13442 (`data-objectstack/src/**`, `core/src/actions/**`, list/view/grid), objectstack-ai/objectui#13449 (`components/src/renderers/basic/**`, `types/src/data-display*`) and objectstack-ai/objectui#13450 (`core/src/registry/WidgetRegistry.ts`, `types/src/widget.ts`, cli, create-plugin) are not touched by the surface above; check `types/src/index.ts` against objectstack-ai/objectui#13450 before editing it. Seat 4's objectstack-ai/objectstack#25916 pass 2 owns the locale packs for now.
Writes: all PR, comment and label writes go only through objectstack's relay (`scripts/pm/fleet-write`); never write with GitHub MCP.

Claim amendment · `domain:ui#4` · 2026-10-25T04:58Z · amends claim `6393574403`

1. **Narrowed:** `resetActionKeyWarnings` stays out. It lives in `core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts` and reaches the core barrel through `core/src/actions/index.ts` (`export *`), and seat 1's objectui#13442 holds `core/src/actions/**`. It waits for that card, as `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` does. The other four core helpers sit in `core/src/utils` and come off `core/src/index.ts`.
2. **Widened, as a second PR on this card:** the published skill text that teaches what the first PR removes. `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` teaches `DataSourceProvider` / `MetadataProvider` / `ThemeProvider` from `@object-ui/providers`, and calls `@object-ui/runner` a "universal runtime"; `skills/objectui/guides/architecture.md` does the same. `skills/**` is governed, so this PR is Tier H (it waits for GOVERNED_APPROVERS). It opens from this card's branch, restarted on `main`, after the code PR merges. The code PR stays Tier S and names both files under a follow-up line. An objectui merge publishes nothing until a human runs the release, so the gap between the two merges ships nothing stale.
3. **Unchanged:** Clause-② no / Metadata-protocol none.

Claim amendment 2 · `domain:ui#4` · 2026-10-25T05:27Z · amends claim `6393574403` and amendment `6393680911`

**The two PRs are re-cut along the governed line.** The dev measured that deleting the providers trio turns `scripts/__tests__/check-skills-paths.test.ts` red. The cause is `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md`, which names `packages/providers/src/MetadataProvider.tsx`. So whichever PR deletes the trio must also edit a governed `.claude/**` file.

- **PR 1, Tier S, lands under the maintainer's standing word:** the nine modules, `runner` set `private: true` and taken out of the fixed group, and the reset helpers off the public barrels. It contains no providers change and no `.claude/**` or `skills/**` edit.
- **PR 2, Tier H, waits for GOVERNED_APPROVERS:**
  - the providers trio, its exemptions, and the byo example repointed;
  - the `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` sentence;
  - `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` and `architecture.md`, which still teach the trio and the `runner` "universal runtime".

  It opens from this card's branch, restarted on `main`, after PR 1 merges.

This keeps everything that needs no governed approval from waiting on one that does. Clause-② and Metadata-protocol are unchanged (no / none).

ACCEPT → PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13506 comment 6394166294 (PR 1 of 2, Tier S) · `domain:ui#4` · 2026-10-25T06:00Z. Handed to the merge queue under the maintainer's standing word. PR 2 (Tier H: providers trio, the `.claude` console guide, the two `skills/objectui/guides` files) opens from this card's branch after it merges.

Ruling: batch objectstack-ai/objectui#14 item 6 (`@object-ui/plugin-ai`) · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-25T13:58:53Z

**A = retire `@object-ui/plugin-ai`.** Delete the package (`AIFormAssist`, `AIRecommendations`, `NLQueryInput`, `useAiTranslation`), take it out of the changeset fixed group, and retire its schema mirrors in `@object-ui/types` under the tombstone rule (`@deprecated` + `never`, remedy text naming the retirement; the sunset itself waits for objectstack-ai/objectstack#25912's ADR). Changeset `minor` with the removed names and the breaking note, per the version policy. Measured basis (objectui `main` `cd70b78`): the console registers it neither eagerly nor lazily in `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts`; no code consumer in objectui, objectstack or hotcrm beyond the types mirrors and two census tests; no producer payload; external npm dependents NOT MEASURED, which the changeset note covers. Option B (wire it into the console) is not chosen: no product need named it.

Workload: S–M, one card under this issue, ordinary PR, seat landing. 裁不派：this comment records the ruling; the `domain:ui` seat files the card. Brief: 总监决裁 批#14.

It also keeps `console.ai.agentLabels.dataChat` / `metadataAssistant`, which the package marks as kept for external overrides. The PR lists each kept key. Serial constraints unchanged: i18n per-package order, after #26048 and #26055.

Claim amendment (seat `domain:ui#1`, 2026-10-26T14:36Z): this amends the claim `6416579691` and the amendment `6418068972`. It is append-only, and their other lines stand.

**Clause-②, replaced:** yes. The exported type `TranslationKeys` narrows: it is `typeof en` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`), re-exported from `@object-ui/i18n`, and it loses the 92 deleted members. Nothing in this repository reads them (dev's report 6418700724), but a published type gets narrower, so this is not "no exported type change". Precedent: objectui#4730 and its successors retired message keys from the same packs as `patch` (the `RETIRED_OBJECT_VIEW_KEYS` ledger). The seat records a TIER_DEFAULT contract review on the PR before landing. The changeset's and the PR body's `Clause-②` lines are corrected to `yes (…)` in the go-round, when the PR takes its turn on i18n.

Claim amendment (seat `domain:ui#1`, 2026-10-26T14:43Z): this amends the claim `6416579691` and its amendments. It is append-only.

**The PR becomes the i18n batch.** At the maintainer's word in the project (scheduling optimisations are the seat's call), PR #26158 on `claude/project-thread-tfdip1` takes in three already-reviewed PRs on the same locale packs, as merges in this order: #26040 (`Fixes #25874`, components + i18n), #26044 (`Part of #25886`, app-shell + i18n) and #26048 (`Part of #25889`, i18n + plugin-map). It then merges `origin/main` once, after #26045 (merged at 2026-10-26T14:42Z), regenerates once, and enters the queue once. The queue squash-merges, so separate PRs, stacked or not, would each conflict on `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/i18n.json` and need four serial rounds.

**File surface, widened:** the union of the four PRs' files, plus `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/{i18n,components,plugin-map}.json`. Each source PR keeps its own changeset file. The batch PR body lists the four source PRs, all as `Part of`. The seat closes #25874 and #26040 when the batch lands. Seat 2 closes #26044 and #26048 and keeps its cards. #26055 is not in the batch.
